background: UBS Group is Switzerland's only remaining global bank after absorbing Credit Suisse, the world's largest wealth manager, with Swiss retail and corporate banking, asset management and an investment bank, and a balance sheet far larger than the Swiss economy.
synthesis: Fitch rates the group A+ after its upgrade on 14 Apr 2026 and S&P A-, both stable, holding-company grades that sit below the operating bank's. The site holds no peer group for the group, so the ratios stand on their own: CET1 is 14.4%, leverage 5.8%, LCR 177% and NSFR 115%, and none has moved materially over the past four periods. The flagged news is mixed: a money-laundering fine on 3 Aug 2026, set against a trading-led profit surge on 28 Jul 2026 and 29 Jul 2026. The Credit Suisse integration and the Swiss debate over capital requirements are the things to watch.
